svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: arduino uno pinout of the mini casino
svg.desc: every uno pin with the part on it: keypad on d3 to d8, a0, a1, rc522 on d9 to d13, oled on a4 a5, buzzer on d2, a2 and a3 free, d0 and d1 reserved for usb
svg.text: arduino uno r3, seen from above, usb on top. every used pin, the part on it and its wire colour.
